articles.summary: Third quarter sales decreased 2.4%; comparable store sales increased 0.6% Third quarter 2013 loss per share of $0.11 compared with $0.25 loss last year SAVANNAH, Ga. --(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Citi Trends, Inc. (NASDAQ:CTRN) today reported results for the third quarter of fiscal 2013.
articles.title: Citi Trends Announces Third Quarter 2013 Results
